verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is an app listing showing "4 triggers" alongside actions. That implies event-based triggers exist in the catalog, but nothing shows a user defining rules that fire actions automatically. The other "automatic" mentions describe tool loading and auth handling, not event-driven automation. Missing for 10: documentation of how triggers are configured or subscribed to via MCP, any rule-definition or condition logic, evidence that triggers chain to actions automatically, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
